E2C 2025 Annual Highlights | 25 Moving Forward As E2C moves forward in 2026, the program is positioned to build on the momentum of its growing portfolio and continue evolving to meet communities’ most pressing and emerging energy challenges. Most notably, as two in‑depth partnership teams prepare to conclude their work in 2026, the program will capture lessons learned, refine approaches, and strengthen models for long‑term community–laboratory collaboration. The year ahead also brings new opportunities to leverage the full breadth of laboratory capabilities across the E2C portfolio. Communities and lab teams will increasingly explore advanced tools and platforms—including microgrid design and analysis, digital twins, and other ARIES capabilities—to support more sophisticated planning, resilience strategies, and system‑level decision making. DOE‑funded investments in national laboratory capabilities will help communities anticipate emerging issues, test solutions before deployment, and accelerate implementation with greater confidence. Together, these developments signal a year of continued innovation and deeper technical engagement. By expanding its ability to address evolving energy needs while advancing Lab capabilities through real‑world community partnerships, E2C will continue supporting practical, scalable, and community‑driven energy solutions in 2026 and beyond.
